SELECT DISTINCT MST.CUSTOMER_NAME fundManager FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MST INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN ON FIN.MANAGER = MST.CUSTOMER_ID where
FIN.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND MST.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = #{yes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
